user_request: Frame a practical launch mandate for Stocknote. Recommend the next decision, success evidence, boundaries, and unresolved owner choices from this packet.

trusted_context.authority: Advice only. Five weeks, $2,800 research budget, and six support hours weekly are available. No launch or commercial commitments are approved.

source_records.text: We want 90 paying workshops at $160 monthly by week five. Stocknote turns manually entered stock counts into reorder suggestions. No payment system exists.
Three unpaid workshops tried the prototype with assistance. Two returned. One manager said stockouts felt less frequent; no stockout baseline or counterfactual was collected.
Each new workshop currently needs four support hours. Operations wants fewer emergency replenishment trips. Access to historical trip records has not been agreed.
